college_identity.identity_notes: One of ten new NITs established 2010. Classes initially began at VNIT Nagpur before shifting to Aizawl in 2011. Currently operates from a temporary, rented, multi-block campus (academic blocks and 4 hostel blocks spread across separate locations — three hostel blocks at Tanhril, one at Durtlang — requiring significant travel between blocks). A permanent campus (~190-191 acres) near Lengpui Airport has been under construction since a 2012 foundation-stone laying, with reviews consistently describing it as still 2-3+ years from completion. Explicitly verified DISTINCT from Mizoram University (a separate central university) and other unrelated Aizawl institutions (RIPANS, ICFAI University Mizoram, College of Teachers Education) that appeared in adjacent search results.

aspect_evidence.evidence_summary: 'Electricity is almost 24/7. Wi-Fi speed is decent, but one may face problems with it on particular floors.'

'Faculty members are supportive. Students' skill development often gets prioritized over other work. You can literally grab knowledge from professors in classes, they don't hesitate to tell even the basics to students.'
'Not much of a crowd. Students actively participate in extracurricular activities. Events are fun, and all students are given equal opportunities.'

'College is located a good distance from hostel so students have to do daily travel which is very scary in this type of route[s]. And blocks are also located a long distance.'
